svg.title: How a machine verifies and unnests an industrial credential
svg.desc: A machine checking the same stored battery claim through A and envelope-only B1. The dual-proof nested example in Appendix A additionally verifies the inner graph proof. Unnesting includes authentication, disclosure reconstruction and controlled interpretation; decoding alone proves nothing. The displayed timings cover prototype portions of the process, not all steps or complete security checks. A cached mapping can replace fresh expansion only under a policy protecting its source binding, freshness and status. Source: paper [full paper], Sections 5.2–5.5; explanatory diagram added in this edition.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: How a machine verifies and unnests an industrial credential

A machine checking the same stored battery claim through A and envelope-only B1. The dual-proof nested example in Appendix A additionally verifies the inner graph proof. Unnesting includes authentication, disclosure reconstruction and controlled interpretation; decoding alone proves nothing. The displayed timings cover prototype portions of the process, not all steps or complete security checks. A cached mapping can replace fresh expansion only under a policy protecting its source binding, freshness and status. Source: paper [full paper], Sections 5.2–5.5; explanatory diagram added in this edition.
